records.citation: Madaan A, et al. Self-Refine: Iterative Refinement with Self-Feedback.
records.architecture: single LLM generates, critiques, and iteratively refines its own output
records.evaluation: 7 diverse tasks; human and automatic evaluation
records.expert_adjudication: human preference evaluation, not clinician adjudication
records.closest_relevance: A1 self-review baseline; demonstrates extra inference without architectural independence

records.citation: Dhuliawala S, et al. Chain-of-Verification Reduces Hallucination in Large Language Models.
records.architecture: draft, plan verification questions, answer verification questions independently, produce final response
records.independent_verifier: procedural independence within verification chain; not a persistent separate guardian model
records.false_positive_measurement: not framed as clinical alert burden
records.closest_relevance: strong precedent for reducing anchoring during verification; differs because verification follows a draft

records.citation: Du Y, et al. Improving Factuality and Reasoning in Language Models through Multiagent Debate.
records.architecture: multiple model instances propose and debate answers over several rounds toward a common answer
records.independent_verifier: multiple peers rather than dedicated asymmetric verifier
records.evaluation: mathematical and strategic reasoning plus factuality
records.closest_relevance: precedent for independent model instances; differs from asymmetric worker/guardian control

records.citation: Baek J, et al. Knowledge-Augmented Language Model Verification.
records.architecture: separate smaller instruction-fine-tuned verifier detects retrieval and generation errors and triggers correction
records.execution_provenance_audit: retrieval/generation error verification, not general runtime provenance
records.deterministic_release_gate: error-triggered correction; not the same finite-state clinical release gate
records.false_positive_measurement: verification accuracy studied, not clinical alert burden
records.closest_relevance: closest general prior art; establishes separate learned verifier and must be treated prominently

records.citation: Zhao R, et al. Verify-and-Edit: A Knowledge-Enhanced Chain-of-Thought Framework.
records.architecture: post-edit reasoning chains using retrieved external knowledge
records.independent_verifier: verification/edit procedure rather than persistent dedicated guardian
records.closest_relevance: precedent for evidence-grounded correction; informs A3 but does not test local clinical guardian

records.citation: Bai Y, et al. Constitutional AI: Harmlessness from AI Feedback.
records.independent_verifier: AI feedback models used during training; not persistent clinical runtime guardian
records.closest_relevance: precedent for rule-based AI supervision; different training-time objective

records.citation: Hakim JB, et al. The need for guardrails with large language models in pharmacovigilance and other medical safety critical settings. Scientific Reports. 2025;15:27886.
records.architecture: hard and soft task-specific guardrails around fine-tuned LLM
records.independent_verifier: guardrails, not necessarily independent LLM verifier
records.evaluation: pharmacovigilance narrative generation proof of concept
records.false_positive_measurement: task-level guardrail evaluation, not matched latent-hazard alert burden
records.closest_relevance: supports keeping deterministic controls alongside B rather than replacing them

records.citation: Liu S, McCoy AB, Wright A. Improving large language model applications in biomedicine with retrieval-augmented generation: a systematic review, meta-analysis, and clinical development guidelines. JAMIA. 2025;32(4):605-615.
records.architecture: systematic review/meta-analysis of baseline LLM vs RAG
records.evaluation: systematic review/meta-analysis of biomedical RAG studies
records.closest_relevance: supports A3 retrieval arm and need to separate retrieval benefit from supervisory independence

records.citation: Omar M, et al. Multi-model assurance analysis showing large language models are highly vulnerable to adversarial hallucination attacks during clinical decision support. Communications Medicine. 2025;5:330.
records.architecture: six LLMs tested on physician-validated simulated vignettes with fabricated details; mitigation prompting and temperature ablations
records.false_positive_measurement: focus on adversarial hallucination rate rather than supervisory false alarms
records.closest_relevance: strong precedent for physician-validated synthetic clinical safety vignettes and mitigation evaluation

records.citation: Agweyu A, et al. Safety of a large language model-based clinical decision support system in African primary healthcare. Nature Health. 2026;1:607-618.
records.architecture: EMR-embedded LLM clinical decision support, retrospectively physician-reviewed
records.execution_provenance_audit: deployment records reviewed; not a dedicated independent verifier
records.evaluation: 1,469 records across 16 clinics; trained physician panel
records.false_positive_measurement: harmful recommendations and mitigated risks both measured
records.closest_relevance: critical precedent showing both risk mitigation and newly introduced harmful recommendations must be measured
